evidence: HPO `subclass_of` adds **nothing** (0.4625 → 0.4629) while doubling nodes to 29,382.
observation: A five-seed RGCN ablation separated phenotype annotation value from ontology size. Keeping disease phenotypes without subclass already captured the gain; restricting phenotypes to terms annotated to at least five graph diseases kept the gain with 1,454 extra nodes, while adding MONDO disease ancestry on top of core+HPO lowered the typed score.

title: HPO subclass adds 16,238 nodes for +0.0004 macro; MONDO ancestry is negative
